flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key containing agreement issues. Only issues in this project are sent to Zoho Sign.

flowVariables.name: ZOHO_SIGN_BASE_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Zoho Sign API host for the target account or environment.

flowVariables.name: ZOHO_SIGN_CREATE_SIGNATURE_PATH
flowVariables.instruction: Zoho Sign API path that creates and sends a signature request from a template. Adjust the request body and response id JSONPath if your endpoint differs.

flowVariables.name: ZOHO_SIGN_TEMPLATE_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Zoho Sign template ID used to create the agreement signature request.

flowVariables.name: ZOHO_SIGN_SIGNER_ROLE_NAME
flowVariables.instruction: Zoho Sign signer role name used by the configured template, if supported by the provider.

flowVariables.instruction: Paste the trigger URL from the Zoho Sign Incoming Status flow after it is created.
